bugs.title: LED wired to wrong pin (D12 instead of D13)
bugs.description: Line 6 defines LED_PIN as 12, but the spec requires the user LED on D13, so every setLed() call on lines 19/35 drives the wrong pin and D13 never follows the button. The measured evidence shows D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms at 902 ms in the rapid-press scenario and for 292 ms at 1.11 s under bounce, consistent with D13 never being driven at all. D13 was in the wrong state for 721 ms across 15 interval(s), first at 902 ms: D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms while required (grace 100 ms).
